text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:

2. **#4419**: gatehouse barcode scanners failing to read trailer tags at Door 14. Source: `teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md`, Moss's undated North cheat sheet.

The Q2 wrap note (`members/marcus-lindqvist/notes/2025-07-14-marcus-q2-expansion-wrap.md`) also cites #4419, but describes it as a Gate 3 printer lag and bol printout delay. That doesn't match the barcode-scanner description, so either two different problems share the number or one note is wrong. Confirm with Thea or Marcus before you put it in the weekly notes.
